Other.name: CompilerCleanup
Other.note: Cleanup files after compiling, Params: File passed to CompileQVM

Other.name: ConfigRead
Other.note: Read game config file, Params:  File: 'LOCAL:config.qsc'

Other.name: ConfigWrite
Other.note: Write game config file, Params: File: 'LOCAL:config.qsc'

Other.name: CutsceneDelete
Other.note: Delete current cutscene, Params: Buffer of size 30.

Other.name: ErrorShow
Other.note: Show error message from game, Params: Error message.

Other.name: FramesSet
Other.note: Set game frames, Params: 30,60 max 240FPS.

Other.name: GameMaterialLoad
Other.note: Load game material.qvm to memory.

Other.name: GraphOpen
Other.note: Open graph of level,Params: with str 'Graph4019.dat'

Other.name: LogAdd
Other.note: Add internal game log message., Params: message to log.

Other.name: LevelLoad
Other.note: Load current level from level_path,Params: path: 0057B568, len: 0x1E.

Other.name: LevelQuit
Other.note: Quit current level to mainmenu.

Other.name: LevelRestart
Other.note: Restarts current level.

Other.name: LevelStart
Other.note: Start new level, Params:  p1: 0057BABC

Other.name: MusicDisable
Other.note: Disable Game Music, Params:  Buffer of size 30.

Other.name: MusicEnable
Other.note: Enable Game Music, Params: Buffer of size 30.

Other.name: MusicSetSfxVolume
Other.note: Sets sound effect volume, Params: volume range [0.0 - 1.0]

Other.name: MusicSetVolume
Other.note: Sets music volume., Params: volume range [0.0 - 1.0]

Other.name: MusicUpdateVolume
Other.note: Update current music volume, Params: Buffer of size 30.

Other.name: QhashInit
Other.note: Init hash table value, Params: hash value 0 or 1.

Other.name: QhashReset
Other.note: Reset QTask type hash table.

Other.name: QscCompile
Other.note: Compile QSC file to QVM, Params: QSC script file like 'LOCAL:objects.qsc'

Other.name: QtaskUpdate
Other.note: Update QTask hash table call before loading level.

Other.name: QtaskUpdateList
Other.note: Update all QTask list, Params: p1 ??

Other.name: ScriptInit
Other.signature: void ScriptInit(char* file_name,int p2,int p3,int p4);
Other.note: Init script buffer for Assembler, Params: Use QvmLoad(file_name) first.

Other.name: ScriptSetsymbolCxt
Other.note: Set symbol context before loading it, Params: symbol_name like 'TaskType_Set'.

Other.name: StatusMessageClear
Other.note: Clear current status message from screen not from memory, Params: Buffer of size 30.

Other.name: StatusMessageShow
Other.note: Show status message on screen, Params: msg to show, sprite of msg, status_timer 0xA758AC, status_byte &0x567C74.

Other.name: SymbolRemove
Other.note: Remove symbol from memory, Params: symbol_name like 'TaskType_Set', p1 pointer ??

Other.name: TasktypeSet
Other.note: Defines new constants for game and scripts ,Params: task_str (int**)WEAPONTYPE_PISTOL, task_id

Other.name: WarningShow
Other.note: Show warning message, Params: message to show.

Other.name: SymbolCheck
Other.note: Check symbol in QTask list if already loaded, Params: symbol_name like 'TaskType_Set', p1,p3 ??

Other.name: ScriptBufInit
Other.note: Init buffer for scripts, Params: buffers with last param as size.

Other.name: SoundLoad
Other.note: Load all level sounds from path , Params: Path of sound like 'MISSION:sounds'

Other.name: MemoryAlloc
Other.note: Allocate memory for game, Params: Check calloc() in c.

Other.name: MemoryDealloc
Other.note: Deallocate allocated memory.

Other.name: MissionOpen
Other.note: Open current mission file , Params: Pointer to mission file.

Other.name: FileOpen
Other.note: Open file for reading or writing, Params: Check fopen() in c.

Other.name: QFileOpen
Other.note: Open Qfile (QSC,QVM) for reading or writing, Params: Check fopen() in c.

Other.name: RigidDyncubeObjRead
Other.note: Read rigid dynCube config file , Params: config file of rigid dynCube.

Other.name: MagicObjLoad
Other.note: Loads magic objects from path, Params: Path 'LOCAL:magicobj'

Other.name: GameDataSymbolLoad
Other.note: Load game data symbol to buffer for game like internal vairables,UI controls,timers etc. Params: like (buf,'LOCAL:models/%s.mef','000_02_1')

Other.name: GameDataSymbolRemove
Other.note: Removes game data symbol for game like internal vairables,UI controls,timers etc.

Other.name: SymbolRegisterBool8
Other.note: Register new symbol of type 'Boolean' for game like internal vairables,UI controls,timers etc.

Other.name: SymbolRegisterInt16
Other.note: Register new symbol of type 'Int16' for game like internal vairables,UI controls,timers etc.

Other.name: SymbolRegisterInt32
Other.note: Register new symbol of type 'Int32' for game like internal vairables,UI controls,timers etc.

Other.name: SymbolRegisterReal32
Other.note: Register new symbol of type 'Real32 aka Float' for game like internal vairables,UI controls,timers etc.

Other.note: Show menu loading screen before loading level.

Other.note: Main Hash Table for QTasks types for Objects(Guns,Ammo,Scripts,Variables etc) in whole game. HashTable is 70bytes long for each QTask.

Other.name: AIAction_Dead
Other.note: Triggers death state, animation, and drop weapon behavior.

Other.name: AIAction_Activate
Other.signature: void AIAction_Activate(int object_id, int action_id, float duration);
Other.note: Triggers interactable object activation (alarm button, door switch).

Other.name: AIAction_FireAtNode
Other.signature: void AIAction_FireAtNode(int node_id, int weapon_id, int burst_count, float delay, int aim_mode);
Other.note: Fires weapon at a specific world node location.

Other.name: AIAction_FireAtTask
Other.signature: void AIAction_FireAtTask(int task_id, int weapon_id, int burst_count, float delay, int aim_mode);
Other.note: Fires weapon at target task object (player or camera).

Other.note: Triggers grenade kick reaction sequence.

Other.name: AIAction_RunPanicking
Other.note: Orders unarmed civilian/guard to run panicking away.

Other.name: AIFunction_DefaultHandler
Other.note: Default fallback script event handler.

Other.note: Clears pending alarm switch activation goals.

Other.name: AIFunction_SetEventPriority
Other.note: Sets event queue evaluation priority for guard script.

Other.name: AIFunction_SetInvulnerability
Other.note: Sets invulnerability flag (1 = godmode / mission object).

Other.name: AIFunction_SetInstantDeath
Other.note: Forces immediate death on single bullet hit.

Other.name: AIFunction_SetAlarmAccess
Other.note: Sets guard permission to trigger alarms.

Other.name: AIFunction_SetScriptIntegerValue
Other.note: Sets internal integer script state variable.

Other.name: AIFunction_SetScriptRealValue
Other.note: Sets internal float script state variable.

Other.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmTriggerID
Other.note: Returns linked alarm trigger task ID.

Other.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmControlID
Other.note: Returns linked alarm control panel task ID.

Other.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmAccess
Other.note: Returns guard alarm access permissions.

Other.name: AIFunction_GetGunnerID
Other.note: Returns linked stationary gun task ID.

Other.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmControlStatus
Other.note: Queries if global level alarm is active (0 or 1).

Other.name: AIFunction_GetGunnerStatus
Other.note: Queries if linked gunner turret is occupied.

Other.name: AIFunction_GetScriptIntegerValue
Other.note: Reads integer script state variable.

Other.name: AIFunction_GetCurrentEventType
Other.note: Returns active detected event type (Gunshot, Vision, Impact).

Other.name: AIFunction_IsEventBehind
Other.note: Returns 1 if detected sound/event originates behind guard.

Other.name: AIFunction_GetScriptRealValue
Other.note: Reads float script state variable.

Other.name: AIFunction_GetRandomValue
Other.note: Generates random float between 0.0 and max using PRNG 0x4B4740.

Other.name: AIFunction_GetEventDistance
Other.note: Returns distance to detected event origin.

Other.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmTriggerDistance
Other.note: Returns distance between guard and alarm switch.

Other.note: Instantiates new task node in level task tree hierarchy.

Other.note: Declares parameter schema and value types for a task node type.
